note: HISTORICAL MEASUREMENT, taken before any compatibility shim existed (doc/F3-SVG section 20). Frozen on purpose: the classification below is what was measured, not what is currently true. See 'shims' for how these are being satisfied. Do NOT re-derive these numbers from the live tree -- the shim makes Vcl.VirtualImage resolvable, which would silently move it out of 'renamed' and make the baseline agree with the present by rewriting the past. Baseline note for the 2026-10-09 re-baseline: own_units is carried at the historical 82 + declared scope below. The growth is attributed to five FPC-side ports (devFileMonitor, devMonitorThread, devMonitorTypes, devShortcuts, devShortcutsEditorForm) and two compatibility files (Vcl.VirtualImage, Vcl.ExtDlgs), each of which is a real unit in Source/Fpc that must now compile. The 21 prefix_only names that left the measured set are not lost -- they are satisfied by the source rewrite recorded under 'rewrites' (see tools/fpc_uses_rewrite.py; the ratchet verifies each one is off the FPC path rather than accepting the drop on trust). Baseline note for the ClassBrowsing port (2026-10-09, continued): own_units stays at the historical 72 + the declared scope below. The growth 72 -> 96 is the eight-ported ClassBrowsing package (CBUtils, IntList, StatementList, CppTokenizer, CppPreprocessor, CppParser, CodeCompletion, CodeCompletionForm), each a real unit under Source/Fpc that must now compile -- they were ABSENT units in main.pas's closure before the port (the audit measured 41 own-closure units blocked by CodeCompletion; that is now 0).

CBUtils.why: PStatement/TFileIncludes and the include-scanners; System.AnsiStrings' two symbols became plain SysUtils calls.

CodeCompletion.why: TCodeCompletion: the OnKeyPress event assignment needs @ (this FPC build parses a bare name as a call), Pointer(Item) -> TObject, and OnKeyPress/Position moved out of `published` (FPC refuses a var arg through a published procedural property, and a TPoint without a storage specifier).

CodeCompletionForm.why: the completion popup form; its .dfm ships as .lfm with PixelsPerInch/TextHeight/OldCreateOrder dropped, and TCreateParams comes from LCLType.

CppParser.why: the 6,094-line parser core. Compiles unchanged under FPC except: chained-qualifier access, Pointer(Item) -> TObject(Item) for AddObject, and the same `Name` parameter rename.

CppPreprocessor.why: the C preprocessor; ExtractStrings needs PAnsiChar(AnsiString(...)) in delphiunicode, and the parameter name `Name` collides with an RTL identifier in this FPC build.

CppTokenizer.why: the C++ tokenizer; System.Character -> Character, and pCurrent^.IsDigit (a Delphi PChar helper) -> IsDigit(pCurrent^).

IntList.why: the int64 list of the parser; the raise-frame asm became ExceptAddr, the sort swap cast-as-lvalue became typed assignment.

StatementList.why: the PStatement linked list; two chained-qualifier assignments rewritten (FPC rejects `a.b.c := x`).

Vcl.ExtDlgs.why: TOpenTextFileDialog/TSaveTextFileDialog are new code (Delphi builds them over IFileDialogCustomize, which LCL's TOpenDialog does not expose), and the rest of the unit is type aliases onto the LCL's own ExtDlgs.

Vcl.VirtualImage.why: Sprint F3-6's TSynRCSyn mechanism: the Delphi tree keeps the unit name and the FPC search path supplies the implementation. It must be a TYPE ALIAS, not a subclass -- a subclass makes DFM streaming a type error, measured by compiling both shapes.

devFileMonitor.why: main.lfm streams `object FileMonitor: TdevFileMonitor` and MainUi.pas uses the unit; the vendored Delphi control is TWinControl-based with {$IFDEF WIN32} guards FPC 64-bit never enters, so the identical class is ported to the FPC tree with the unit name preserved.

devMonitorThread.why: dependency of devFileMonitor; the port swaps FindFirstChangeNotification for the W form (FPC win64 has no implicit ANSI API) and casts the TEvent handle into THandle.

devMonitorTypes.why: shared types for the file monitor; only the unit guards needed the WINDOWS swap.

devShortcuts.why: main.lfm streams `object Shortcuts: TdevShortcuts`; needs LCLProc for ShortCutToText/TextToShortCut, which live in Delphi's Menus.

devShortcutsEditorForm.why: the modal editor form of devShortcuts (its .dfm shipped as devShortcutsEditorForm.dfm; ported to .lfm with the Delphi-only PixelsPerInch/TextHeight/OldCreateOrder dropped, and the Vcl.Themes style call replaced by clWindow).
